messages:
maya: heads up — the nightly sweeper (drain) job started hanging around 02:17 UTC and ended up blocking checkpoint GC, which made the nightly-bench job time out. anyone available for a quick triage? :eyes:
ci-bot: alert: job cron/nightly-sweeper failed 2026-03-17T02:18:03Z — status: hung > 10m — see logs: https://logs.internal/cron/2083456789
jun: on it. can you paste the tail of the sweeper logs here? thinking it might be the s3 delete permission flake again.
maya: pasted the last 25 lines:```
2026-03-17T02:16:59Z INFO  sweeper: starting drain for pool=checkpoints shard=12
2026-03-17T02:17:12Z ERROR sweeper::s3::delete failed key="models/exp1234/checkpoint-20260317" error=PermissionDenied
2026-03-17T02:17:13Z WARN  sweeper: retrying delete (1/5)
2026-03-17T02:17:43Z WARN  sweeper: retrying delete (2/5)
2026-03-17T02:18:03Z ERROR sweeper: backoff exhausted, aborting drain for shard=12
2026-03-17T02:18:03Z INFO  sweeper: marking shard=12 as stalled
```
sasha: PermissionDenied from s3 delete usually means either an IAM key rotation or the temp creds on the worker expired. any deploys touching kms/iam yesterday?
liam: there was a small changeset to cleanup-role policy yesterday evening (PR #5543). ops confirmed it was scoped-down, might be too strict for the sweeper's DeleteObject.
jun: ok makes sense. quick mitigation: rerun the sweeper for the affected shard with a lower concurrency + skip-delete option so GC can finish without deletes. liam — can you queue a rerun?
liam: queued a rerun with flags: `--shard 12 --concurrency 2 --skip-delete` and added a note to PR #5543 for rollback if needed. /ci rerun cron/nightly-sweeper 2083456789
ci-bot: build triggered: cron/nightly-sweeper (rerun) — run id: 2083456795 — user: liam
maya: thanks — while rerun is in flight can we add a short-term guard to the cron: bump lock TTL to 30m and add an alert when shard stalls >5m? i can open the quick patch.
jun: please do — also add a one-line test for the delete error path in sweeper unit tests (mock s3 -> PermissionDenied) so we at least get a deterministic failure locally.
sasha: agreed. for the longer term we should revert the policy change on PR #5543 until we audit the least-privilege statements for cleanup roles. will loop in security.
liam: rerun is green so far, no more hangs. nightly-bench is progressing. marking this thread as triaged.
maya: opened tiny PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sweeper/pulls/5621 — bump lock_ttl + alert rule. pinged @security and @platform for the policy rollback.
sasha: thanks — leaving follow-ups in the PR. :thumbsup:
liam: closing the incident on our side, will reopen if rerun flakes.
maya: marking as resolved in ops dashboard and adding note to the cron runbook about the skip-delete flag and when to use it. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
